about: Claims rows for the store listing (BL-1337; FR-MKT-08, FR-MKT-09, FR-MKT-11). Read by packages/content/test/store-listing-words.test.ts, never by the app, and not exported from the package. When a sentence of store.en.ts changes, change its row here in the same pull request: say is the sentence exactly as the listing has it, needs names the build facts it depends on ('servers on', 'our backup off', 'English only'), and source is audit:<row of docs/store/SCREENSHOT-COPY-AUDIT.md>, a D-id or a repo path. {brand.name}, {brand.web.terms} and {brand.web.privacy} are filled from packages/brand. whatsNewFrames are What's New sentences that name no feature; whatsNewFeatures are the only clauses What's New may name, each with the description heading of its claim and the production build switch it needs (null for a v1.0 feature with none); keywords are the only words the keyword field may hold, each with its source.

claims.say: Tell your child about today.
A minute is plenty.
It stays in your words.
Every word we change is marked, and your original recording is kept unchanged.
{brand.name}: letters to your child, in your own words and voice.
Tell your child one thing about today.
The first laugh, the long night, the song you made up in the car.
It becomes a letter in your own words, with your voice kept beside it.
Years from now, your child can read it, and hear how you sounded when you said it.
IT STAYS IN YOUR WORDS
Your words are written down on your phone, and the app only fixes small slips, like an um, a repeat or a name spelled your way.
It never adds a word.
Every word we change is marked, and you can put any of them back.
We never rewrite your words, shorten them or write for you.
A word can be misheard, so have a quick read before you keep a letter.
Letters you type stay as you typed them.
YOUR VOICE, KEPT
Every letter you speak keeps its recording, on your phone and in your iPhone's own backup if you use one.
We never imitate your voice.
Your original recording is always kept exactly as you made it.
READ TOGETHER AT BEDTIME
Open Read together and go through the book one letter at a time, oldest first.
Listen to the letters you spoke, with the words on the screen.
Typed letters are there too, for you to read aloud.
A MINUTE IS PLENTY
Some nights it's a sentence, some nights a long letter.
Stuck for words?
There's a question to start with.
If today was quiet, tap "Not much today" and that's enough.
Nothing keeps score.
A BOOK THAT GROWS BY MONTH

claims.say: NAMES SPELLED YOUR WAY
Add the names and home words you use, like a nickname or the name of a stuffed rabbit, so we spell them your way.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your letters and recordings are private.
We never sell them, never use them for ads and never use them to train machine learning models.
You sign in to keep your book.
If you agree to sync, the words of your letters and your child's name and dates are kept on our servers so they reach a new phone.
Recordings stay on the phone that made them.
Keep any letter just for you, out of the book.
Delete one and it waits in Recently deleted for 30 days.
REMINDERS, ONLY IF YOU WANT THEM
Reminders are off until you turn them on.
You pick the days and the time, and none comes after 9:30 at night.
TAKE IT WITH YOU
Export your book any time, for free: your letters, your recordings and a PDF of the book.
IN ENGLISH
This version writes down letters spoken in English.
The speech model is a one-time download, on Wi-Fi unless you turn on cellular data, 575 MB on most iPhones and smaller on some, and you choose when it starts.
Until it is ready, your recordings are kept and the words follow.
PLUS
Your first two letters are free, so you can see how it feels.
To keep adding letters, choose Plus: $4.99 a month with the first month free, or $49.99 a year with the first 2 months free.
The free months are for people new to Plus.
One plan covers every child's book and works with Family Sharing.
A new letter past the free two waits until you decide.
Every letter you have kept stays yours to read, play and export, with or without Plus.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account.
Plus renews automatically unless you turn off renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings.
For parents of babies and young children, from the first weeks to the first years.
